items.headline: $ATOS Crashes 94% After Bridge Drained on Ethereum
items.summary: Atoshi's bridge lost 201 million $ATOS on Ethereum, with the exploiter netting only ~$60K via KyberSwap. The token plunged 94% within an hour across two Uniswap pools.

items.headline: $ZRO: LayerZero Names 40+ Validators for Zero Launch
items.summary: LayerZero revealed its launch validator set for the new Zero chain, including Kakao Pay and Broadridge. Staked $ZRO deposits will be split evenly across the launch validators.

items.headline: $RUNE: Binance Hack Flows Through THORChain Top $600M
items.summary: Reuters estimates over $600M in stolen Binance funds have moved through THORChain, though double-counting is possible. The FBI has asked $RUNE node operators to block theft-linked transactions.

items.headline: $XMR Sinks Below $400 as KuCoin Pulls the Plug
items.summary: Monero dropped over 10% in 24 hours as KuCoin confirmed it will end all $XMR spot trading on Nov. 30. Privacy rival $ZEC rallied in the opposite direction.

items.headline: $GRAM: Telegram Cuts Gift Resale Fee to 2%
items.summary: Telegram slashed fees on gift resales paid in Gram, with sellers now paid directly in $GRAM when sales settle on TON. Durov is pushing the in-app onchain economy.
